dwarves.plan: Aggro. Get three artifacts, legends or Sagas out by turn 3 to switch on Storied, suit up your Dwarves and attack every turn before the opponent's big creatures and board wipes arrive.

Belladonna Took.role: Card engine for your tokens: Treasures, Axes, Dwarf tokens and Soldiers all count.
Belladonna Took.play: Play her before a turn that makes two tokens (Dori plus a Blacksmith, or At the Door) so the second token draws you a card.

Celebrate the Mountain-king.role: Removal that also filters your hand and can leave a Soldier token.
Celebrate the Mountain-king.play: Hold it for the opponent's best permanent, ideally a Pest engine like Dina or a big Daemogoth. Discard an extra land to the recruit.

Dáin, Lord of the Iron Hills.role: Cheap legend for Storied that taxes the opponent's attacks.
Dáin, Lord of the Iron Hills.play: Turn-2 play. Once Storied is on, every attacker costs them 1 mana, which slows Pest swarms.

Ori, Keeper of Songs.role: Efficient 3-drop that becomes a 4/3 vigilance attacker with Storied.
Ori, Keeper of Songs.play: Play after you have two other artifacts or legends out so he attacks as a 4/3 right away.

The Queen of Dale.role: Cheap legend that punishes the opponent's spells with recruit.
The Queen of Dale.play: Play early. She counts for Storied and draws you through your deck whenever they cast removal or a board wipe.

Stone by Sunlight.role: Instant answer to a big creature, or protection for your best attacker.
Stone by Sunlight.play: Keep 2 mana up on their turn: kill a creature with power 4 or more, or make your Thorin indestructible against a wipe.

Burn, Burn, Tree and Fern.role: Saga removal: 6 damage, then kills an artifact, then ramps you.
Burn, Burn, Tree and Fern.play: Cast it when they have a real target. It counts as a Saga for Storied, and chapters III and IV give red mana for Smaug or Thorin, Mountain-king.

Dáin Ironfoot.role: Gives every equipped attacker double strike.
Dáin Ironfoot.play: Play him with an Axe already on board, then attack with everything equipped. Blacksmith with an Axe hits for 4 double strike.

Dori, Bearer of Friends.play: Play Dori before Smaug the Magnificent: her Treasure makes Smaug's attack deal extra damage and ramps you a turn ahead.

The Misty Mountains Cold.role: Makes a Treasure every turn and can turn into a 6/6 flying Dragon.
The Misty Mountains Cold.play: Best on turn 3 with Dori or Smaug out. The Treasures also count for Storied and fuel Smaug's attack trigger.

Pinecone Strike.role: Cheap instant removal that exiles, or kills a Pest or Treasure token.
Pinecone Strike.play: Use it on blockers before combat, or choose both modes to kill a creature and a token at once.

Smaug the Magnificent.role: Your finisher: 4/3 flying haste that grows his damage with every Treasure.
Smaug the Magnificent.play: Play him on turn 4 after Dori or Misty Mountains Cold. He makes a Treasure each upkeep, so every attack hits harder.

Thorin, Mountain-king.role: Moves all your Equipment onto one creature and fights with it.
Thorin, Mountain-king.play: Cast him when you have two or more Equipment out: stack them on your biggest Dwarf, which then deals that much damage to their best blocker.

Dwarven Mattock.role: +2/+2 and ward 1, auto-attached to a Dwarf for 2 mana.
Dwarven Mattock.play: Cast it right after a Dwarf. It makes the Lonely Mountain cheaper and counts as an artifact for Storied.

Key to the Side-Door.role: Makes your biggest attacker unblockable, or turns spare legends into cards.
Key to the Side-Door.play: Use it on the creature carrying the Equipment. Discard a second copy of a legend you already have out to draw two.

My Precious.role: Hexproof and unblockable on one creature.
My Precious.play: Put it on your best double-strike attacker when they have blockers or targeted removal. The other half needs black mana, so ignore it.

Thrór's Map.role: Legendary artifact that finds a land and smooths your draws.
Thrór's Map.play: Turn-2 play when you need a land or Storied pieces. Later, loot away extra lands for gas.

Iron Hills.role: Dual land that can grow a Dwarf by +2 late in the game.
Iron Hills.play: Play it on turns where it entering tapped costs nothing. Late game, sacrifice it for two counters on your biggest Dwarf.

The Lonely Mountain.role: Mountain that makes 2/2 Dwarves, cheaper per Equipment.
The Lonely Mountain.play: Play it after your first Equipment so it enters untapped. With 2 to 3 Equipment out, make a Dwarf every turn.

Thorin Oakenshield.role: Turn-2 attacker that gives your whole board ward 1 with Storied.
Thorin Oakenshield.play: Your best turn-2 play. Ward 1 taxes the opponent's removal on everything you control.

Dáin's Company.role: 2-drop with lifelink that digs for a Dwarf or Equipment.
Dáin's Company.play: Play it on turn 2 when you lack a 3-drop. Take an Equipment if you have Dwarves, otherwise a Dwarf.

Iron Hills Blacksmith.play: Turn-2 play that adds an Equipment for the Lonely Mountain. Equip the Axe to the Blacksmith itself for 4 damage.

Sting, Bilbo's Sword.role: Flash Equipment that grows with the opponent's creature count.
Sting, Bilbo's Sword.play: Flash it in on their end step or during combat when they have many Pests. Each of their creatures adds +1/+0.

Glóin the Mighty.role: Pest sweeper first, 4/3 ramp creature later.
Glóin the Mighty.play: Cast Easy Pickings to kill all their 1-toughness Pests, then cast Glóin from exile. He adds two red mana every turn.

Fíli the Pathfinder.role: Anthem with Storied and a token engine for every nontoken Dwarf.
Fíli the Pathfinder.play: Play him before your other Dwarves so each later Dwarf brings a 2/2 token, which also triggers Belladonna.

Kíli the Resourceful.role: Card draw for every Dwarf or Equipment and free equipping.
Kíli the Resourceful.play: Turn-2 play. With Storied, equip for free once a turn, which saves you 2 to 3 mana each turn.

An Unexpected Party.role: Either a wave of Dwarf tokens or +2/+2 for all Dwarves.
An Unexpected Party.play: Early, cast At the Door for X Dwarves. Later, cast the enchantment from exile naming Dwarf to pump the whole team.

Dwalin, Weaponmaster.role: First striker that permanently pumps all your Equipment.
Dwalin, Weaponmaster.play: Play him once two or more Equipment are out. Every attack adds another +1/+0 to each Equipment.

spares.Balin, Loremaster: Swap in for My Precious to refill your hand late and deal damage with Storied.
spares.Dwalin, Weaponmaster: Second copy for decks heavy on Equipment.

wolves.plan: Midrange. Trade early with deathtouch Wolves and cheap removal, then take over with creatures of power 4 or more. Ferocious triggers, Wolf tokens and card draw win the long game.

Bilbo's Deadly Slice.play: Save it for threats you can't beat in combat, like a big Daemogoth or Dina.

Gnashing of Teeth.role: Exile removal or a mini sweeper against tokens.
Gnashing of Teeth.play: Use -1/-1 to wipe a board of 1/1 Pests, or -5/-5 to exile a recursive creature.

Head of the Hunt.role: Flash 4/3 that exiles their dying creatures and makes Wolves.
Head of the Hunt.play: Flash it in before you cast removal or block. Every creature of theirs that dies afterwards becomes a 2/2 Wolf for you and can't come back.

The Master of Lake-town.role: Deathtouch blocker that mills on every life loss.
The Master of Lake-town.play: A good turn-3 wall. Holds off bigger attackers while your other cards set up.

Ravening Warg.role: Deathtouch 2-drop that gains life with Ferocious.
Ravening Warg.play: Play early to trade with anything. Attack once you control a 4-power creature to gain 2 life.

Reverent Howl.role: Card draw, or a combat trick with lifelink.
Reverent Howl.play: Draw two at the end of their turn when the board is quiet, or pump a blocker to win a fight.

Bejeweled Warg.role: Trampling 2-drop that grows Wolves or makes Treasure.
Bejeweled Warg.play: Attack when it can connect; take a Treasure early for ramp, counters later.

Gigantic Big Bear.play: Cast it when they're tapped out or low on blockers. It can't be countered and dodges targeted removal.

Old Fat Spider.role: 6/7 reach wall that draws when targeted.
Old Fat Spider.play: Turn-6 play that stops flyers and turns on Ferocious for every Wolf.

Quarrel.play: Point your biggest creature at their best one. After Duskwatch Hunter's counter, a 4-power Wolf kills most things.

Wargling.role: 2-drop that gives your whole team trample with Ferocious.
Wargling.play: Attack with it alongside a 4-power creature so every attacker tramples over chump blockers.

The Chief Warg.role: Card engine: draws a card every attack with Ferocious.
The Chief Warg.play: Play once you have a 4-power creature. Attack every turn to draw, even with just one attacker.

Chief Warg's Company.role: 5/3 trample that makes a Wolf every upkeep.
Chief Warg's Company.play: Play it early so the Wolves pile up. It can attack once you have two other Wolves.

Duskwatch Hunter.play: On turn 3, put the counter on itself for a 4/2 that tokens can't block, or on another Wolf to make it 4 power.

Large Bear.play: Hits immediately and turns on Ferocious the turn it lands.

Tom, Bert, and William.role: 5/5 card engine that comes back as an artifact.
Tom, Bert, and William.play: Sacrifice a Wolf token or a creature about to die in response to removal to draw cards.

Mirkwood.role: Dual land that can grow a Wolf, Bear or Spider by +2.
Mirkwood.play: Late game, sacrifice it to make a Wolf 4 power and switch on Ferocious.

Rhovanion Rampager.role: Attacker that eats your creatures to grow.
Rhovanion Rampager.play: Sacrifice a Wolf token or a doomed creature on attack. When it dies you get a Goblin Army that big.

spares.Old Fat Spider: Swap in a second copy against flyers.
spares.Ordinary Bear: Swap in for a cheap 4/5 that turns on Ferocious.

spares.Troll Negotiations: Swap in for removal that also grows your creature.
spares.Warg Tactics: Swap in against flyers or targeted removal.
spares.Wargling: Fourth copy for more trample turns.
spares.Part in Friendship: Swap in against board wipes; creatures you lose get replaced.

goblins.plan: Removal and Amass. Kill everything that matters, keep feeding counters to one Goblin Army, and let The Great Goblin and Bolg turn those counters into damage.

Bilbo's Deadly Slice.play: Kill their engine creature at the end of their turn, or a blocker before Bolg attacks.

Gnashing of Teeth.role: Exile removal, or -1/-1 to sweep Pests.
Gnashing of Teeth.play: Use the sweeper mode when they have three or more 1/1 tokens; your Army survives.

Gollum the Abandoned.role: Graveyard hate, 2 life loss, and a reusable sac outlet.
Gollum the Abandoned.play: Play him when their graveyard has a Bloodghast or similar. Later return him by sacrificing a token.

Stir Up Trouble.role: 1-mana removal that sacrifices a token or creature.
Stir Up Trouble.play: Sacrifice a Treasure, a Flunkies or a dying creature. It feeds The Great Goblin's card draw.

Bothersome Noisemaker.role: Grows your Army with every noncreature spell.
Bothersome Noisemaker.play: Play it early. Each removal spell afterwards also adds a counter to the Army.

Goblin-town Flunkies.role: Haste 1/1 that starts or grows the Army.
Goblin-town Flunkies.play: Turn-2 play. Later it's sacrifice food for Stir Up Trouble or Bolg.

Misty Mountains Raider.role: 4/4 that adds two Army counters every attack.
Misty Mountains Raider.play: Play before The Great Goblin is out; every attack then also pings them for 2.

Tidings of War.role: Cheap Army growth, again from the graveyard.
Tidings of War.play: Cast it early for 1 counter, then flash it back late for 3.

Bolg of the North.role: 5/5 removal: sacrifice a creature to deal its power in damage.
Bolg of the North.play: Sacrifice your Army for big damage on their best creature; excess damage comes back as a new Army.

Bolg's Company.role: Haste 2/2 that turns spare Goblins into mana.
Bolg's Company.play: Sacrifice a Flunkies for two mana to cast Bolg or Smaug a turn early.

Goblin Plate Mail.role: Grows the Army and gives it menace.
Goblin Plate Mail.play: Cast it once you have an Army so it gets +1/+0 and menace right away.

Smaug, Wicked Worm.role: 5/5 flyer that draws when you spend Treasure.
Smaug, Wicked Worm.play: Best after The Sackville-Bagginses made a Treasure; spend it on your next spell to draw.

Goblin-town.role: Dual land that can grow a Goblin by +2.
Goblin-town.play: Late game, sacrifice it to grow the Army and trigger The Great Goblin.

Rage into the Valley.role: Draws a card and adds two Army counters.
Rage into the Valley.play: Cast it with The Great Goblin out for 2 damage plus the card.

The Great Goblin.role: Turns every Army counter into 2 damage.
The Great Goblin.play: Play him before your Amass spells so each one also pings the opponent.

Gandalf, Spark Starter.role: 6-mana 4/3 reach that kills up to three small creatures.
Gandalf, Spark Starter.play: Split the 3 damage to wipe Pests or finish off damaged creatures.

Dreaded Bat-Cloud.role: Cheap flying deathtouch after any creature died.
Dreaded Bat-Cloud.play: Cast it for 2 mana right after removal or a sacrifice.

Azog, Moria's Ruin.play: Destroy your own Flunkies to draw a card and grow your Army, or their biggest threat if it's worth giving them an Army.

Glóin the Mighty.role: Pest sweeper, then a 4/3 ramp creature.
Glóin the Mighty.play: Cast Easy Pickings to kill their 1-toughness tokens, then Glóin from exile for extra red mana.

The Sackville-Bagginses.role: Sac outlet that draws a card and drains on every token you sacrifice.
The Sackville-Bagginses.play: Sacrifice a token or a doomed creature on entry for a card and a Treasure.

humans.plan: Tempo and card draw. Draw your second card every turn to grow Bard, the Apothecaries and the Flock, hold counterspells for board wipes and win in the air.

Lake-town Toymaker.role: 4-toughness body that gives +3/+0 and first strike after you draw two.
Lake-town Toymaker.play: Draw your second card before combat (Plunder, Bilbo, recruit) so its trigger pumps your best attacker.

The Queen of Dale.role: Recruits whenever the opponent casts a noncreature spell.
The Queen of Dale.play: Play early; she turns their removal into extra cards and Soldiers.

Bilbo, Luckwearer.role: Unblockable 1/1 that loots on every hit.
Bilbo, Luckwearer.play: Turn-2 play. Every connect counts as a second draw for Bard and the Apothecary.

Bilbo Baggins, Burglar.role: 3-drop that draws on entry, or Scry 2.
Bilbo Baggins, Burglar.play: Cast Take a Glance on turn 1 to set up, then Bilbo himself later from exile.

Confusticate and Bebother.play: Hold it up for their board wipe; if they don't cast one, draw two at end of turn.

Enchanted River's Grasp.role: Locks down a creature and wipes its counters.
Enchanted River's Grasp.play: Put it on their biggest threat or the creature carrying counters.

Great Gilded Boat.play: Crew it with a Soldier token or Bilbo; each attack draws, discards and may add a Soldier.

Lakeshore Apothecary.role: Grows +1/+1 every turn you draw two cards.
Lakeshore Apothecary.play: Play on turn 2 and keep drawing your second card every turn.

Plunder the Trollshaws.role: Instant draw, flashback for two more.
Plunder the Trollshaws.play: Cast it on their turn for your second draw; flash it back later for two cards.

Ravenhill Flock.role: Flyer that grows with every card you draw.
Ravenhill Flock.play: Play it before a draw-heavy turn; it quickly outgrows their blockers in the air.

Sound the Trumpets.role: Hard counterspell that recruits on cheap targets.
Sound the Trumpets.play: Save it for a board wipe or their best creature.

Uncover the Moon-Letters.play: Play when you have counterspells and draw spells in hand; each cast refills you.

Uneasy Partings.role: Removal that puts a creature into their library.
Uneasy Partings.play: Cast it on an attacker for 1 less; it beats indestructible and recursion.

Wizard's Staff.play: Put it on Bard the Bowman or Bard's Company to double their trigger.

Bard the Bowman.role: Your payoff: a +1/+1 counter and lifelink every second draw.
Bard the Bowman.play: Play before your draw spells; with Wizard's Staff he puts out two counters a turn.

Bard's Company.role: Anthem with flash that recruits on entry and attack.
Bard's Company.play: Flash it in at the end of their turn when you control a Human.

Patient Instructor.play: Play it when you need a body and a second draw in the same turn.

Lake-town.role: Dual land that can grow a Human by +2.
Lake-town.play: Late game, sacrifice it for two counters on Bard.

The Lord of the Eagles.role: Flash 8/8 flyer, cheaper per flyer you control.
The Lord of the Eagles.play: With Ravenhill Flocks out it costs very little; flash it in on their end step.

Riddles in the Dark.role: Card advantage that lets them pick a pile.
Riddles in the Dark.play: Cast at the end of their turn; either pile gives you two cards.

elves.plan: Ramp and Landfall. Play extra lands every turn, let each land drop grow your Elves and make tokens, then finish with big Landfall turns.

Elven Raft-Steerer.role: Taps a blocker or untaps your creature on every land drop.
Elven Raft-Steerer.play: Play before your land for the turn so the trigger taps their best blocker.

Enchanted River's Grasp.play: Use on a creature you can't fight with Quarrel.

Mirkwood Meditator.role: 2/4 blocker that becomes a 4/2 attacker on land drops.
Mirkwood Meditator.play: Block on their turn, then play a land on yours and attack as a 4/2.

Beorn, Reluctant Host.role: Extra land drop now, a 5/5 trampler later.
Beorn, Reluctant Host.play: Cast Till and Tend early for an extra Landfall turn, then Beorn from exile.

Beorn's Hospitality.role: A +1/+1 counter on every land drop, later a big Bear.
Beorn's Hospitality.play: Play it before your land drops; in the late game turn it into a Bear as big as your land count.

Boughside Wanderers.role: Finds a permanent and swings big on land drops.
Boughside Wanderers.play: Play it then a land in the same turn so it attacks as a 6/6.

Down in the Valley.role: Finds a land, then makes an Elf per land drop.
Down in the Valley.play: Turn-3 play: chapter I finds a land, chapter II makes tokens.

Galion, Elvenking's Butler.role: 4/4 that copies its size onto another attacker.
Galion, Elvenking's Butler.play: Attack with Galion and an Elf token; the token becomes a 4/4.

Guardian of the Halls.role: Cheap trampler with a late-game mana sink.
Guardian of the Halls.play: Turn-2 play; later pump it with spare mana.

Mirkwood Pathmaker.role: Grows with every land you control.
Mirkwood Pathmaker.play: Gets bigger every turn; best after extra land drops.

Quarrel.play: Point a Landfall-pumped creature at their threat after your land drop.

Radagast of Rhosgobel.role: Makes your first creature each turn 2 cheaper and flash.
Radagast of Rhosgobel.play: Play him early; then cast creatures on their end step.

Warg Tactics.role: Kills a flyer, or protects and pumps your creature.
Warg Tactics.play: Hold it up for their removal or flying threats.

Wood Elves.role: Puts a Forest onto the battlefield: ramp plus a Landfall trigger.
Wood Elves.play: Turn-3 play; every Landfall card on board triggers from its Forest.

Mirkwood Nurturer.role: Bounces a land to replay it for another Landfall.
Mirkwood Nurturer.play: Return a tapped land, then replay it as your land drop for a second trigger.

Silvan Reveler.role: Loots on entry and puts a discarded land into play.
Silvan Reveler.play: Discard a land to ramp; it can come back from your graveyard with Landfall.

Thranduil, Sindarin Liege.role: Elf anthem that makes an Elf token on each land drop.
Thranduil, Sindarin Liege.play: Play before your land drops for the most tokens.

Thranduil's Company.role: Extra land drop each turn and two counters per land.
Thranduil's Company.play: Play it with another Elf out to play two lands a turn.

Elven Passage.role: Fetches a basic, untapped if you show an Elf.
Elven Passage.play: Crack it for an extra Landfall trigger.

Elvenking's Halls.role: Dual land that can grow an Elf by +2.
Elvenking's Halls.play: Late game, sacrifice it for counters on your best Elf.

Hobbit Hole.role: Fetches a basic for an extra Landfall trigger.
Hobbit Hole.play: Crack it the turn you have the most Landfall cards out.

Cantankerous Keepers.role: Card advantage that gets cheaper per Elf.
Cantankerous Keepers.play: Cast it once you have three Elves for a 2-mana refill.
